The '''R-10 Combat Saboteur''' was a model of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
